title: Session browsing omits collected native transcripts because it reads daemon-local metadata
wanted_capability: Browse retained native Claude Code and Codex sessions by recency with project/account filters and bounded pagination, without requiring producer filesystem roots on the corpus daemon.
missing_primitive: A corpus-owned session summary enumeration consumed by bbox_sessions_list. The current implementation only reads local Claude usage-data/session-meta and Codex session files.
fallback_used: Use bbox_search to discover native locators and exact session ids, then bbox_session for indexed metadata and source freshness.
evidence: 2026-09-10 live bbox_sessions_list(limit=3) returned No sessions found while bbox_search returned native user messages timestamped the same day.
2026-09-10 live bbox_session reported completed producer scan at 17:45:47 UTC: 756 discovered, zero failed/deferred, sampled indexed generations matched published generations.
notes: Distinct from addressed gap-e40feb8f (native ingestion) and addressed gap-72fd5932 (project-filter matching). The tool description acknowledges metadata-only coverage but ordinary recency browsing remains unavailable for collected sessions. Preserve source/account identity, generation deduplication, and indexed-projection limitations.
